requirements_summary: POC scope: ingest 90 days of historical tickets (Zendesk), generate concise 1-line summaries + 3 bullet highlights, extract standard tags (issue_type, product_area, intent, urgency), webhooks to create macros in Zendesk, live agent assist drawer with model confidence and edit suggestions. Targets: avg summary latency <300ms for cached/common templates, batch throughput to handle 1.5k tickets/day with 2x spike tolerance. Accuracy tolerance: tag precision >=90% initially, aim for 95% after tuning. Data residency: US-only for now. Audit logging required for all inference calls.
